Some of my best conversations of the year happen at FUSION. Not on a slide, but over a coffee between sessions, when a customer tells me what keeps them up at night. 

On 4 November, we're bringing that energy back to Munich for FUSION München 2026 at the Sofitel Bayerpost, and I'm genuinely excited about what we have lined up for the DACH community... and some of our best partners are there to show you whats possible!

Here's what I'm looking forward to most:
→ Fresh from Las Vegas: the latest launches from FUSION Las Vegas, brought to you right here in the DACH region. Our product and technology direction from
Raghu Malpani
, Chief Product & Technology Officer at UiPath. Also meet our P&E leadership
Mircea G.
George Barnett
in person.
→ From AI hype to orchestrated ROI: how to move beyond pilots and proofs of concept, and securely orchestrate agentic workflows across AI agents, robots, systems and people
→ Real customer stories: hearing directly from our customers and partners (agenda:
https://lnkd.in/e4ysM_wG
)
→ An independent view:
Neil Ward-Dutton
, Research VP for Agentic Automation & AI Technologies at IDC

What I value most about FUSION is that you leave with practical ideas, new connections, and a clearer view of how to turn AI into measurable business results.

I'd love to see you in Munich!

#FUSIONMünchen
